title: Gartner 2024 B2B rep-free buying and self-service purchase regret
statement:
Gartner reported in 2024 that 75% of B2B buyers preferred a rep-free purchase experience, while buyers using self-service digital commerce were 1.65 times more likely to experience purchase regret than those using traditional sales channels, implying that self-service landing pages should expose enough evaluative information to support independent decisions while retaining an optional human path. (Gartner)
